purpose: README concept mockups; not hardware-test photographs

images.prompt: Create a straightforward documentary concept mockup for an open-source PebbleOS Linux port README. Landscape 3:2 image. Think small hardware project on someone's actual desk, not an advertisement. A silver Samsung Galaxy Watch3 SM-R850 with a black rotating bezel, two oblong buttons on its right, traditional lugs and a slightly used black leather strap lies flat on a plain dark-gray desk mat. Close enough that its circular screen is the main readable object. The supporting input image is the actual captured PebbleOS launcher; reproduce this bitmap UI faithfully inside the screen, including white circular field, cyan Settings row and black Settings, Music, Notifications labels. Keep the low-resolution character, do not smooth it into a new UI. The corner of a modest laptop keyboard and a little of its terminal are at the left edge, secondary to the watch; the only readable terminal command is exactly "cmake --build build-galaxy". No fake success logs, benchmark numbers, hardware validation results or health data. A simple USB charging puck cable can lie loosely behind the watch; do not invent a USB port or wired debugger attached to the watch itself. Ordinary diffuse window light, honest close photograph, mild everyday wear, matte surfaces, quiet natural colors. Entire watch case is visible with comfortable margins. No studio pedestal, dramatic rim lighting, glow, gradients, glossy 3D CGI look, floating objects, oversize logos, decorative circuit boards, hacker props or marketing typography. Only overlay is a tiny legible lower-left label "Concept mockup". The mood is someone building and testing a Linux watch port in their spare time.

Create a plain documentary concept mockup for a technical GitHub README. Landscape 3:2. Close candid view of a cropped adult wrist resting beside an ordinary laptop keyboard at a desk, no face visible, a little neutral cotton sleeve. A silver Samsung Galaxy Watch3 SM-R850, 41mm circular case, black physical rotating bezel, two oblong buttons on the right side, black lightly worn leather strap. Realistic modest size on the wrist, no giant luxury watch. The supporting input is the captured PebbleOS watchface: orange face, broad white outer ring, gray Roman numerals, white minute hand and thick black hour hand. Use it faithfully inside the round screen; do not invent a Samsung face, health data or notification. Natural ambient daylight, slightly imperfect ordinary desk framing, restrained reflections, watch screen sharp and recognizable, keyboard softly out of focus. Aim for a contributor's project log photo rather than a lifestyle ad or polished product render. No spotlight, moody glamour, color grading, neon, fake code graphics, marketing copy, prominent brands or staged tools. Only overlay is the small exact label "Concept mockup" at lower left. The image is explicitly an illustration of the port, not evidence of a completed hardware test.

Create a simple documentary concept mockup for a Linux-watch project's GitHub README, landscape 3:2. A silver Samsung Galaxy Watch3 SM-R850 lies face-up on a slightly worn light-gray work mat on a plain desk. Black physical rotating bezel, two oblong right-hand buttons, traditional lugs and black leather strap with modest wear. Nearly overhead camera, no dramatic perspective, sensible margins around the whole case. Use the supporting captured PebbleOS launcher image faithfully as the watch's round screen: bitmap black labels and icons, white field, cyan selected Settings band, exact Settings, Music and Notifications text. This should look like the small real UI supplied, not an invented modern dashboard. A small plain handwritten paper note beside the watch reads only "PebbleOS / Linux" in ordinary pen. No other props are needed. Soft ordinary room/window light, realistic unpolished project-log photograph, readable screen, minimal glass glare. No showroom sheen, luxury advertising, staged circuit boards, neon, studio gradient, cinematic grading, promotional logos or feature claims. Add only the exact small lower-left caption "Concept mockup" outside the watch. Keep the subject practical and approachable for Linux developers and watch tinkerers.
